question: Round 2, price-only signal and entry fixes: does momentum measured the textbook way (skipping last month, whose winners tend to fall back) pick better, and does a real entry (breakout from a base, a pullback, or a cap on how stretched a name is) beat buying the top of the list at the open?

variants.name: s_skip1m
variants.why: the live RS formula, measured as of a month ago

variants.name: s_12_1
variants.why: 12-month return skipping the last month (textbook momentum)

variants.name: e_breakout
variants.why: buy only on a new closing high on above-average volume

variants.name: e_pullback
variants.why: let names the 50-day room gate turns away enter on a 21-day EMA reclaim

variants.name: e_ext2
variants.why: no entry more than 2 ATRs above the 20-day EMA

variants.name: c_12_1_breakout_spyoff
variants.why: breakout entries may not need the SPY filter

variants.name: c_skip1m_ext2_cap98
variants.why: skip-month ranking, not stretched, no RS 99
